visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Rule written for the wrong selector
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The warning message should be red, but it stays black. The rule was written with a dot, which selects a class, but the element uses an id.
visualizerParams.buggyCode: Disk almost full

solution.code: Disk almost full
solution.explanation: A dot selects the class attribute and a hash selects the id attribute. The selector .warn matches elements with class="warn", so it matched nothing here. Use #warn for the id.
